alierayyagiyanik: Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy came from Dunmarrow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people. The machine gunners took Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy in on a busy morning in R-C11. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
ba_ba_ba_batman: Casimir "Button" Batman reached R-F7 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Casimir "Button" Batman read a letter that said the neighbour had married again. The whole dugout wanted the missing first half of the story. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Casimir "Button" Batman watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Casimir "Button" Batman changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Norbert Slc lent Casimir "Button" Batman a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.

Casimir "Button" Batman borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Casimir "Button" Batman read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Casimir "Button" Batman asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Casimir "Button" Batman added a leak above the man's head in pencil.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Casimir "Button" Batman across the shin at R-F7. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h). Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Button" Batman. Casimir "Button" Batman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F7. Casimir "Button" Batman took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Teodor Shadowizard of the Hegemony (@shadowizard__). Casimir "Button" Batman was killed outright at R-F7, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Teodor Shadowizard of the Hegemony (@shadowizard__).
The papers connected Emil Batman to Casimir "Button" Batman. The men took longer to learn Emil Batman's own habits, but they made the effort.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F7 they left Emil Batman behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Isidor "Tin" Brayden of the Hegemony (@brayden27727).
Zeno "Hollow" Batman arrived carrying the family name of Emil Batman. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
calderthebald: Benedikt Calderthebal arrived on Day 4 as a replacement. The men in R-F5 had been fighting for 3 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Benedikt Calderthebal and Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Calderthebal. Benedikt Calderthebal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Benedikt Calderthebal raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F5. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp of the Concord (@gavinlordofpugs). Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Benedikt Calderthebal could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Benedikt Calderthebal's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Benedikt Calderthebal stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of R-F5, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
Benedikt Calderthebal was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Benedikt Calderthebal ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F5 in the middle of the night. Benedikt Calderthebal met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Tobias Georgia of the Concord (@channel17georgia).
Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal joined R-F5 under the shadow of Benedikt Calderthebal's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
calin._av: On Day 5 Arno "Rabbit" Calin took a post at R-F23 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He sleeps with his boots on, and the men liked him for it.

A bullet found Arno "Rabbit" Calin at R-F23, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Arno "Smokes" Den of the Concord (@ay.den0707). Arno "Rabbit" Calin walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Arno "Rabbit" Calin died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
The House of Calin sent another. Hugo Calin, older brother of Arno "Rabbit" Calin, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Hugo Calin checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
A supply man offered Hugo Calin a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Hugo Calin coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a waltz with a scratched introduction, but something knocks once every revolution.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-F23 changed before the cheering ended. Hugo Calin shouldered another load.
captain_dill_pickles23: Yann Pickles came up on Day 9 carrying news from Oakmere. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Yann Pickles shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
coloradoforwardblake: Dorian Coloradoforw arrived at S-R2 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

In the dark of the Hegemony trench Dorian Coloradoforw hit Nils Noaskevitch with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@noaskevitch) Dorian Coloradoforw counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Pavel Yijoon never saw the shovel coming. (@yijoon09) Dorian Coloradoforw cut his hand to the bone on the wire at Hill 304. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic. Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian Coloradoforw heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
coopergfulton: Arno Coopergfulto came up on Day 5 carrying news from Millbank. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Arno Coopergfulto fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Arno Coopergfulto looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A single shot from across the wire hit Arno Coopergfulto in the thigh at R-F22. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Pavel Yijoon of the Hegemony (@yijoon09).
Arno Coopergfulto drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Arno Coopergfulto returned to R-F22 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
The whole squad at R-F22 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Arno Coopergfulto's bullet that found Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko, grazed.

Arno Coopergfulto was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Arno Coopergfulto kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
djsunspear: Ulrich Djsunspear took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
jeffwiratama: Isidor Jeffwiratama arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a photograph gone soft at the edges and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Shell splinters peppered S-C3. Isidor Jeffwiratama picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Isidor Jeffwiratama wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
kyrie_eleisson: The old hands of T-S9 have been here since Day 1. Viktor Eleisson has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Viktor Eleisson threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Valentin "Ghost" Scotty was down and screaming for a medic. (@scotty01851) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Viktor Eleisson was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Viktor Eleisson kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
luxos8000: By the time Wendel "Whistle" Luxos reached T-F1, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At T-F1 they left Wendel "Whistle" Luxos behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Isidor Stinchgaming of the Hegemony (@stinchgaming25).
The House of Luxos sent another. Marek "Saint" Luxos, older brother of Wendel "Whistle" Luxos, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
marius12214: Valentin Marius told the sergeant he was a farmhand. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Valentin Marius listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
olly.a2019: Tobias Olly came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
person116987345686: The old hands of R-S7 have been here since Day 1. Isidor Person has been here since Day 6. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Isidor Person was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. A letter from home reached Isidor Person before dusk. Isidor Person read it twice and slept a little easier.
Isidor Person and Felix "Tin" Euberitamini made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Isidor Person said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Isidor Person snores. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini does not. Tin now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Isidor Person wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
